summary: Some Network Time Protocol modes need a well-known local port, but others do not, and using it anyway makes blind off-path attacks easier. This document updates RFC 5905 to recommend ephemeral port randomization for modes where the well-known port is not required.

eli5.summary: If the door you always use is easy to guess, a sneaky person can try knocking on it. This document says to use a random door when no fixed door is needed for clock messages.
